profile.story:
Before her beloved departed for war, the two made a solemn promise by the large well at the edge of the village.

"I shall return and we shall wed before these flowers have withered three times."

When the flowers withered for the first time, word spread that the war was nearing its end. Yet, her beloved never came home. Every morning, the young woman drew water from the well, praying earnestly that one day his reflection would appear behind her own in the water's surface.

When the flowers withered a second time, word spread of a crushing defeat in the war. The village echoed day and night with the wailing of the bereaved. But the young woman dismissed the news as mere rumors, and continued to visit the well every morning.

Then, before the flowers could bloom again, word spread that all of the village's able-bodied men had perished. As if they had been waiting for this exact moment, a gang of bandits descended upon the village. The village was consumed by screams and flames in an instant, and the young woman, chased by brigands, found herself cornered at the very well that held so many memories of her beloved.

On that tragic night —before the flowers could bloom a third time— the young woman threw herself down the well without hesitation, praying that she might finally be reunited with her beloved in the afterlife.
